newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle trade very slow at $64 -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle trade very slow at $64 -USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with few sales slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said.

Inquiry was moderate and demand fair. Sales confirmed on 800 slaughter steers and 800 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 137,700 head confirmed including 28,300 head or about 21 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Total volume is a weekly record for Kansas.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 64.00. Slaughter Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs 64.00; few mixed Commercial to Choice 1150 lb heifers with end heiferettes 63.00.
Wk to date - 137,700 last week - 13,200 last week - 31,000
